name: Shadowbroker
description: Open-source intelligence for the global theater. Track everything from the corporate/private jets of the wealthy, and spy satellites, to seismic events in one unified interface. Hook an AI agent up to have it parse through data and find previously unseen correlations. The knowledge is available to all but rarely aggregated in the open, until now.

latest_release.name: v0.9.84
latest_release.body:
## Summary

- **GT Analytics & Strategic Risk** — OpenClaw-driven geopolitical analytics, risk scoring, and map overlays (#392)
- **Telegram OSINT auto-translate** — map popups with source-language labels; Persian (fa) locale + RTL (#472)
- **ACARS datalink + full telemetry** — Airframes datalink on plane dossiers; uncapped world telemetry
- **Saved dashboard layout** — layer toggles, filters, map style, and panel expand/collapse persist in localStorage
- **OpenClaw hardening** — entity profile/trail, fetch-health (#470), agent-shell WS token auth (#409)
- **v0.9.84 UI** — version decal and what's-new modal

## Upgrade paths

| Install type | Path to v0.9.84 |
|---|---|
| **Desktop v0.9.83+** | One-click **Update** (signed Tauri `latest.json` + minisign) |
| **ZIP / source updater** | Auto-update via `SHA256SUMS.txt` integrity chain |
| **Desktop v0.9.82** | One manual MSI install to v0.9.83 first if needed, then one-click to v0.9.84 |
| **Desktop v0.9.79 / v0.9.8** | Manual MSI hop to v0.9.81+ first (signing key reset at v0.9.81), then auto-update |
